meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码库交给多名漏洞猎手和验证工程师并行审查,找出真正可利用的缺陷并定级。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布前想确认代码里没有被忽视的可利用漏洞。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to confirm exploitable flaws before shipping.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会组建一个 5 人团队:3 名漏洞搜寻者并行扫描你指定的代码库,2 名 PoC 工程师用本地小样例验证漏洞是否真能被利用,并按可利用性定级,最后输出含 PASS/BLOCK 结论的报告。
howto.when: 当你提到 “security-research”、“security review”、“vulnerability audit” 等关键词,或要求做发布前安全检查、威胁模型验证时触发;需要团队模式。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a 5-member team: 3 vulnerability hunters scan your codebase in parallel, 2 PoC engineers test exploitability with local toy inputs, severity follows exploitability, and a report ends with a PASS/BLOCK verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "security-research", "security review" or "vulnerability audit", or ask for a pre-release check, threat model validation or /security-research. Requires team mode.

say_en.text: Run a security audit on the current repo and branch diff
say_en.note: Builds a 5-member team and returns a report

say_en.text: Audit this PR's changes and find exploitable vulnerabilities
say_en.note: Each surviving finding gets file paths and a PoC

say_en.text: Verify whether this vulnerability is actually exploitable
say_en.note: PoC engineers try to reproduce it locally
